targets.title: ✦INTRADAY TRADER✦ Can you stay disciplined for 30 days straight? Most can't 👇
targets.author: Intraday trader
targets.text:
Trading discipline for beginners: why 30 days of consistent habits can beat years of random trading, and how to build a simple 30-day discipline plan for intraday trading.
Many traders spend years jumping between strategies, taking random trades and hoping for results. Same market, same charts, but no structure. A trader who follows one plan with strict habits for just 30 days often learns more than someone who trades randomly for years. This video is for every intraday trader who wants to change their results by changing their habits.
Your 30-day discipline plan:
✦ Trade one strategy with fix

targets.title: Stop Loss Mistake: I Moved My Stop and Made $67,000
targets.author: Trading Psychology - Guy Levy
targets.text: My stop loss was $2,500. I moved it to $5,000 and made $67,000 on that trade, and it was one of the biggest mistakes I had in my career. The brain learns by action and by dopamine, and when dopamine tags removing the stop as a positive thing, that's a very bad lesson to the brain. The chart is real market data used as an illustration, not that trade. From my conversation with Piero Arias (@piero.trades), full episode on the channel: The Part of the Brain That Blocks a Profitable Strategy. #shorts #stoploss #tradingpsychology
